register.labelZh: PIN 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: pin somebody down 可以描述某人在運動、緊急情況或危險處境中被牢牢按住。；當你知道事情有問題,卻仍無法找出確切原因、意思或位置時,可以使用 pin something down。；pin something on somebody 可以表示把錯誤、損失或問題的責任推到某人身上,尤其適合描述不公平的指責。；pin something up 可以用來描述在牆上或告示板上張貼告示、海報、相片、地圖和名單等物件。
register.summaryEn: Pin somebody down can describe a person being held firmly during a sport, an emergency or a dangerous situation. Pin something down is useful when you know that something is wrong but cannot yet identify its exact cause, meaning or location. Pin something on somebody describes placing responsibility for a mistake, loss or problem on a particular person, especially when the claim may be unfair. Pin something up is useful for notices, posters, photographs, maps, lists and other items displayed on a wall or board.
